title: 傳單紙怪 3 格像素圖集（姿勢底稿由 AI 產生，江兆耘清理）
prompt: 共通開頭：The attached image is my pixel-art game enemy (a chibi corporate-consultant template), shown ONLY as a reference for the pixel style, thick 1-pixel navy outline, crisp square pixels, and the exact suit colors. Do NOT copy the character.

角色：a small chibi flyer monster; head is an advertising flyer folded in half like a tent (no letters, no red, no teal, no lightning on the paper); small charcoal-suit body, burgundy necktie, small gold lightning-bolt badge with navy outline on the chest; about 28 pixels tall in a 32x32 frame.
姿勢：站姿、ATTACK（一手舉過頭、拋傳單前的起手）、HURT 兼驚訝（圓眼加 O 嘴、傳單頭微皺）；正面、並排、同大小、腳在同一水平線。
各姿勢的完整提示詞原文請作者貼於此處（僅此欄為摘要）
references: 江兆耘的西裝範本站姿（僅作畫風、配色與像素粗細參考，非複製角色）
selected: 站姿、出手、受擊各選 1 張生成圖（原圖未入庫）

post.outline: 江兆耘手修時使用 #182448，之後由 Isaries 統一改為規範的 #0C2D5E
